transcribed_from: IRC/CRC model-code values for dwelling stairways and garage separation (R311.7, R302.6), transcribed for step 6.7a stage S1 (2026-10-09) from the model-code text as known to the student; the CRC 2025 adoption text was not read. Version 0.2.0 (stage S1.1, 2026-10-09) adds the flight rise limit, the door at the top of a stair, the protection of enclosed space under a stair and the half-bath clearances.
verification_note: Separate ruleset for the vertical layer (step 6.7 S1) so the habitability ruleset and the golden packages stay unchanged. All entries verified=false until checked against the CRC 2025 text (California amendments and renumbering of the 2025 cycle).

text: R311.7.5.1: the maximum riser height shall be 7 3/4 inches.
R311.7.5.2: the minimum tread depth shall be 10 inches.
R311.7.1: stairways shall be not less than 36 inches in clear width above the handrail height.
R311.7.2: the minimum headroom in all parts of the stairway shall be 6 feet 8 inches.
R311.7.6: a floor or landing at the top and bottom of each stairway; its depth in the direction of travel not less than 36 inches.

parameters.under_habitable_room: 5/8 in Type X gypsum board or equivalent on the garage ceiling, with the supporting structure protected by 1/2 in gypsum board
parameters.otherwise: 1/2 in gypsum board on the garage side

text: R302.6 / Table R302.6: a garage beneath habitable rooms needs a 5/8 in Type X gypsum ceiling; the separation is a construction requirement, not a planning limit.
R311.7.3: a flight of stairs shall not have a vertical rise larger than 151 inches between floor levels or landings.
R311.7.6 exception: a door at the top of an interior flight is permitted without a landing if it does not swing over the stairs.

parameters.requirement: enclosed accessible space under stairs: walls, under-stair surface and soffits protected on the enclosed side with 1/2 in gypsum board

text: R302.7: enclosed accessible space under stairs shall have walls, under-stair surface and any soffits protected on the enclosed side with 1/2-inch gypsum board.
R307.1 / Figure R307.2: water closet centerline at least 15 in from a side wall and 21 in clear in front; 21 in clear in front of a lavatory.
R305.1 exception: in bathrooms and toilet rooms the ceiling height over the fixture clearance area (and at the centre of the front clearance of the water closet) shall be not less than 6 ft 8 in.
R303.7: interior stairways shall be provided with an artificial light source to illuminate the landings and treads; natural light does not replace it.
Table R302.1(1): openings in exterior walls are not permitted at a fire separation distance under 3 ft, limited to 25% of the wall area from 3 ft to under 5 ft, unlimited at 5 ft or more.
